description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Migrate the project to Java 25 to take advantage of the latest LTS features, performance improvements, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all code compiles and tests pass under Java 25. Address any deprecated or removed APIs. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Updated pom.xml java.version from 21 to 25, and updated Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. No source code changes required. Build and all unit tests pass under Java 25.
